items.title: Building a safe, effective sandbox to enable Codex on Windows
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI built a safe, effective sandbox to enable Codex on Windows with controlled file access and network limits.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI介绍了为Windows平台构建Codex沙箱环境的技术细节，重点在于实现受控的文件访问和网络限制，以确保代码执行的安全性。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于应用层安全工程实践，对模型技术本身的影响有限。

items.title: Our response to the TanStack npm supply chain attack
items.summary: OpenAI details its response to the TanStack “Mini Shai-Hulud” supply chain attack, outlines protections taken to secure systems and signing certificates, and explains why macOS users must update OpenAI apps by June 12, 2026. Learn what happened, what was affected, and how OpenAI is strengthening defenses against evolving software supply chain threats.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI披露了针对TanStack npm包的供应链攻击事件，并采取了系统加固措施。受影响的macOS用户需在2026年6月12日前更新应用。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于软件供应链安全事件，与大模型技术研发无直接关联。
